name: peckboard-pr-review
description: PeckBoard plugin: review a git branch like a pull request. A dedicated agent session gathers the branch's context once, fans the review out to independent claude / codex / grok reviewer subagents, merges and re-verifies their findings in code, and submits one structured result the PR Reviews page renders.

scripts.build: node esbuild.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o dist/plugin.wasm
